verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right. The headline is clear and its subhead sits right under it, and the two photos keep their proportions. Its flaws: the two rotated captions are crammed together at the far left, the tiny tractor thumbnail is close to meaningless, and the grey and olive colour blocks are jammed against the right edge. B's headline nearly collides with the farmer photo. The three tractor thumbnails are shrunk to illegible specks, and 'in Columbus' hangs awkwardly below and to the right of the headline. The rotated 'Tractor Industry' text is wedged against the colour blocks on the right edge, which makes the layout look scattered and unbalanced.
